DELETE FROM her_private.challenges WHERE expires < ?
DELETE FROM her_private.challenges WHERE id = ?
DELETE FROM her_private.operator_limits WHERE expires < ?
DELETE FROM her_private.wallet_sessions WHERE expires < ?
DELETE FROM her_private.wallet_sessions WHERE id = ?

INSERT INTO her_private.burn_intents (id,wallet,kind,character,amount,raw_amount,mint,decimals,program,name,topic,created_at,expires,round_id,transaction_message) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)
INSERT INTO her_private.burn_receipts (id,wallet,kind,character,amount,signature,created_at) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?)
INSERT INTO her_private.challenges (id,wallet,message,expires) VALUES (?,?,?,?)
INSERT INTO her_private.moderation_log (id,request_id,host,action,created_at) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?)

INSERT INTO her_private.operator_limits (id,bucket,attempts,expires) VALUES (?,?,1,?) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET bucket = EXCLUDED.bucket, attempts = CASE WHEN operator_limits.bucket = EXCLUDED.bucket THEN operator_limits.attempts + 1 ELSE 1 END, expires = EXCLUDED.expires RETURNING attempts
INSERT INTO her_private.operator_notes (wallet,mint,thesis,updated_at) VALUES (?,?,?,?) ON CONFLICT (wallet,mint) DO UPDATE SET thesis = EXCLUDED.thesis, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at

INSERT INTO her_private.operator_notes (wallet,mint,thesis,updated_at) VALUES (?,?,?,?) ON CONFLICT (wallet,mint) DO UPDATE SET thesis = EXCLUDED.thesis, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at WHERE operator_notes.updated_at < EXCLUDED.updated_at

INSERT INTO her_private.operator_orders (id,wallet,mint,side,amount,thesis,token_name,symbol,decimals,request_id,transaction_message,unsigned_transaction,out_amount,expires,created_at,status) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)
INSERT INTO her_private.stage_requests (id,wallet,name,topic,status,created_at) VALUES (?,?,?,?,'pending',?)
INSERT INTO her_private.wallet_sessions (id,wallet,expires) VALUES (?,?,?)
SELECT * FROM her_private.burn_intents WHERE id = ? AND wallet = ?
SELECT * FROM her_private.burn_intents WHERE id = ? AND wallet = ? AND expires > ?
SELECT * FROM her_private.burn_receipts ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 200
SELECT * FROM her_private.burn_receipts WHERE signature = ?
SELECT * FROM her_private.burn_receipts WHERE wallet = ? ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT * FROM her_private.challenges WHERE id = ? AND wallet = ? AND expires > ?
SELECT * FROM her_private.character_rounds WHERE settled_at IS NULL ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM her_private.operator_orders WHERE id = ? AND wallet = ?
SELECT DISTINCT character FROM her_private.burn_receipts WHERE wallet = ? AND kind = 'character'
SELECT enabled,desired,actual,revision,heartbeat,healthy FROM her_private.character_control WHERE id=1
SELECT her_private.accept_character_burn(?,?) AS counted
SELECT her_private.advance_character_rounds()

SELECT i.* FROM her_private.burn_intents i LEFT JOIN her_private.burn_receipts b ON b.id=i.id WHERE i.submitted_signature IS NOT NULL AND b.id IS NULL AND i.created_at > ? ORDER BY i.created_at LIMIT 20

SELECT i.character, SUM(b.amount::numeric)::text AS amount, COUNT(*)::integer AS votes FROM her_private.burn_receipts b JOIN her_private.burn_intents i ON i.id=b.id WHERE i.round_id = ? AND b.counted GROUP BY i.character
SELECT id FROM her_private.stage_requests WHERE wallet = ? AND status IN ('pending','accepted','on_stage')
SELECT id,ends_at,winner,reason FROM her_private.character_rounds WHERE settled_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT id,mint,side,amount,thesis,token_name,symbol,status,signature,created_at,expires FROM her_private.operator_orders WHERE wallet = ? ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 30
SELECT id,mint,side,signature,thesis,created_at FROM her_private.operator_orders WHERE wallet = ? AND status IN ('submitting','submitted','unknown') ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 30
SELECT mint,thesis,updated_at FROM her_private.operator_notes WHERE wallet = ? ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT s.*, b.signature,b.amount FROM her_private.stage_requests s JOIN her_private.burn_receipts b ON s.id = b.id ORDER BY s.created_at DESC LIMIT 200
SELECT s.*, b.signature,b.amount FROM her_private.stage_requests s JOIN her_private.burn_receipts b ON s.id = b.id WHERE s.wallet = ? ORDER BY s.created_at DESC LIMIT 30
SELECT status FROM her_private.stage_requests WHERE id = ?
SELECT wallet FROM her_private.wallet_sessions WHERE id = ? AND expires > ?
UPDATE her_private.burn_intents SET submitted_signature = ? WHERE id = ? AND wallet = ?
UPDATE her_private.character_control SET actual=?,heartbeat=?,healthy=? WHERE id=1
UPDATE her_private.operator_orders SET status = 'confirmed' WHERE id = ? AND wallet = ? AND status IN ('submitting','submitted','unknown')
UPDATE her_private.operator_orders SET status = 'submitting', signature = ? WHERE id = ? AND wallet = ? AND status = 'prepared' AND expires > ? RETURNING id
UPDATE her_private.operator_orders SET status = ? WHERE id = ? AND wallet = ? AND status = 'submitting'
UPDATE her_private.stage_requests SET status = ?, invite_url = COALESCE(?,invite_url) WHERE id = ? AND status = ?
